description: Set the jug and the pot, swore, and did not change the latch.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Heard him from below, and said to leave him there.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Spoke once through the ceiling, and then was quiet.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Answered, and left him up there.
name: William Shakespeare
